Activity.description: Unit of work — the service-time/forecast join key. Adding one is a contract change.
Activity.title: Activity

ArrivalMode.description: How a patient reached the ED.
ArrivalMode.title: ArrivalMode

BayFrame.description: Per-frame mutable bay state (the static ``Bay`` geometry is fetched once).
BayFrame.title: BayFrame

BayStatus.description: Dynamic bay status (lives in ``sim.physics.world``, never in ``core.Bay``).
BayStatus.title: BayStatus

BlockEdgeAction.description: Block a corridor edge — a routing-mask delta, not a plan item.
BlockEdgeAction.title: BlockEdgeAction

BumpPriorityAction.description: Move a waiting patient to the head of the bay queue -> ``sequence`` item.
BumpPriorityAction.title: BumpPriorityAction

CloseBayAction.description: Hold/close a bay — a ``ValidationContext`` delta, not a plan item.
CloseBayAction.title: CloseBayAction

CompatibilityRule.description: The single acuity->zone_type / isolation / equipment mapping.
CompatibilityRule.title: CompatibilityRule

CostSpec.description:
DEFERRED — mirrors ``core.cost``. No dollar rates in M1.

Empty now, but ``extra="forbid"`` (inherited from ``FrozenModel``) means a
future stray cost key is validated the day it is added, not silently accepted.
CostSpec.title: CostSpec

DisruptionEvent.description: A scheduled disruption. ``data`` owns the schedule; ``sim`` owns the mechanism.
DisruptionEvent.title: DisruptionEvent

DisruptionSpec.description: The disruption schedule carried by a ``Scenario`` (empty by default).
DisruptionSpec.title: DisruptionSpec

Duration.description: A signed span in microseconds (may be zero; a delta of two instants).
Duration.title: Duration

EsiAcuity.description: Emergency Severity Index. **1 = most critical**, 5 = least critical.
EsiAcuity.title: EsiAcuity

EventEnvelope.description: An event plus its global sequence and optional causal parent sequence.
EventEnvelope.title: EventEnvelope

ExpediteCleanAction.description: Prioritize the pending cleaning task for a bay -> ``clean`` item.
ExpediteCleanAction.title: ExpediteCleanAction

ExpediteDischargeAction.description: Prioritize a patient's pending documentation -> ``discharge`` item.
ExpediteDischargeAction.title: ExpediteDischargeAction

FacilitySpec.description: The ``scale`` argument to ``generate_floor`` — a pure geometry spec.
FacilitySpec.title: FacilitySpec

KpiContrast.description:
One key's baseline-vs-optimized contrast — a projection of
``analysis.compare.Contrast`` (``significant`` is mirrored, never re-derived).
KpiContrast.title: KpiContrast

KpiVector.description: A complete KPI reading — keys are exactly ``KPI_KEYS`` (closed contract).
KpiVector.title: KpiVector

OperatingWeek.description:
The scoring week, ``[start, end)`` (half-open).

The half-open convention is the definition of WIP/LOS censoring: a patient
whose ``DischargeCompleted`` lands at *exactly* ``end`` is **still WIP**, not
a completion — applied identically across arms so they stay comparable.
OperatingWeek.title: OperatingWeek

PatientChip.description: A patient marker: acuity color key, position, stage, and time waited.
PatientChip.title: PatientChip

Plan.description: A complete, revisable set of decisions.
Plan.title: Plan

PlanItem.description:
One decision. ``stable_id`` lets plans diff cleanly across re-solves.

Payload fields are per-kind and optional; a given ``kind`` populates the
subset it needs (e.g. ``assign_bay`` uses ``patient``+``bay``; ``dispatch``
uses ``staff``+``task``; ``sequence`` uses ``patient``+``order``).
PlanItem.title: PlanItem

PrecedenceRule.description: Activity ``before`` must precede activity ``after`` in a patient's order.
PrecedenceRule.title: PrecedenceRule

QueueFrame.description: One waiting stage: its depth and the first-N patients for chip rendering.
QueueFrame.title: QueueFrame

ReassignAction.description: Reassign a waiting patient to a bay -> ``PlanItem(kind="assign_bay")``.
ReassignAction.title: ReassignAction

RerouteAction.description: Direct a specific staff member to a pending task -> ``dispatch`` item.
RerouteAction.title: RerouteAction

Scenario.description: The complete, versioned scenario: facility + workload + staffing + schedule.
Scenario.title: Scenario

ScenarioInline.description:
A stored base scenario plus dotted-path slider overrides.

Keys are dotted paths into the ``Scenario`` document (e.g.
``"workload.base_rate_per_hour"``); values replace the addressed leaf. The
compiled overlay is validated by ``data.scenario.apply_overlay``.
ScenarioInline.title: ScenarioInline

SessionState.description: The authoritative playback state returned by every control call.
SessionState.title: SessionState

ShiftBlock.description: A staffing window with its role headcounts (M1: a static input, not solved).
ShiftBlock.title: ShiftBlock

SimTime.description: An absolute instant in microseconds since the scenario epoch (>= 0).
SimTime.title: SimTime

SkillRule.description: Skills a task-kind requires of the staff performing it.
SkillRule.title: SkillRule

StaffKinematic.description: Rendering-shaped staff state — NOT a domain type (doc 07 §7.2).
StaffKinematic.title: StaffKinematic

StaffingSpec.description: Static staffing input: explicit shift blocks plus a default coverage level.
StaffingSpec.title: StaffingSpec

StreamFrame.description: One streamed projection of live world state (doc 07 §7.2).
StreamFrame.title: StreamFrame

TaskId.description: Identifies a unit of pending work.
TaskId.title: TaskId

TimeWindow.description: A half-open interval ``[start, end)`` of the sim clock.
TimeWindow.title: TimeWindow

Violation.description: A single rule breach. ``kind`` discriminates; ``entity`` names the culprit.
Violation.title: Violation

WorkloadSpec.description: The one-week arrival + attribute-mix spec consumed by ``generate_workload``.
WorkloadSpec.title: WorkloadSpec

ZoneQuota.description: One acute-care zone's bay allocation (a ``facility.zones`` entry).
ZoneQuota.title: ZoneQuota

ZoneType.description: Functional type of a care zone.
ZoneType.title: ZoneType

post.description:
Create a run session at ``t=0`` (paused unless ``start="playing"``);
``compare_to`` spins a same-seed shadow arm so CRN holds.

get.description:
Baseline-vs-optimized deltas via the one ``analysis`` bootstrap.

Both paired logs are folded at the same cut (the lagging arm's ``sim_time``)
so the contrast compares the same realized window under CRN.

post.description:
Playback control. Commands mirror to the paired shadow arm so a live
comparison advances both arms under the same operator clock.

get.description: The live ``core.kpi.KpiVector``: the one fold over the log so far.

post.description: A validated operator action: applied atomically or rejected verbatim.

get.description: SSE fallback (read-only): the same frames as ``data:`` lines.

post.description: Validate slider overrides through ``data.scenario`` and store the result.
